summary: Blocking gaps affect design-run activation, protected questions, verification and test coverage.

findings.summary: Non-Pen design requests have no reliable activation path into the new role.
findings.evidence: Routing requires an existing saved design context, but preflight at line 52 creates that context only for Pen references and worktree creation at line 76 moves it only for active Pen work. Figma, image and text requests can therefore reach plan without the context needed to classify or route them. Constitution I requires core behavior to agree with DESIGN.md's UI-design routing; ENG-15 requires an explicit state contract.
findings.fix: Activate and persist design context for each supported source kind before plan, including discovery of sources first encountered later, then route from that recorded state.

findings.summary: Implement-stage scope questions have no orchestrator relay and resume path.
findings.evidence: The role must return protected questions for missing targets and shared-component scope changes, but SKILL.md's implement section handles only partial returns; its needs_input relay at lines 82-85 is specific to spec-builder stages. Constitution IV requires agent questions to reach the user through the orchestrator, and ENG-15 requires explicit handling of this result.
findings.fix: Handle ui-designer needs_input in implement: relay protected questions, persist their answers outside transient relay state, and respawn the same assigned task range with the decisions.

findings.summary: Text-only runs cannot satisfy the stated verified-gate condition.
findings.evidence: Text-only mapping and fidelity must be recorded as not_applicable, while line 96 permits implementation status verified only when all gates pass. ui-designer.md line 27 requires verified gates or a scoped waiver for done, so an ordinary text-only restyle cannot complete without contradicting the contract or seeking an unnecessary waiver. ENG-15 requires consistent state and completion contracts.
findings.fix: Define verified completion as all applicable gates passing and all legitimately non-applicable gates carrying their required reasons; align the role's done condition.

findings.summary: Quality-pass edits can invalidate evidence after the last verification.
findings.evidence: The role runs ui-agent after gates pass and records applied recommendations, but does not require re-running gates or committing changes afterward. design-code-mapping.md requires current code identity and invalidates evidence on code changes; Constitution IV requires resumable state on disk. ENG-26 requires integrity across partial changes.
findings.fix: Commit applied quality-pass changes and their recorded outcome, invalidate affected evidence, and rerun applicable gates before reporting done.

findings.summary: New evidence-path containment behavior has no asserting test.
findings.evidence: The new is_relative_to check rejects traversal and symlink escapes, but the added drop tests assert only ordinary existing files and a missing file. No test would fail if containment were removed, leaving this new integrity boundary unprotected. ENG-1 requires asserting tests for added behavior and important boundaries.
findings.fix: Add drop tests for a traversal reference and a symlink escaping the design directory, asserting refusal and unchanged map and run artifacts.

findings.summary: Verification excludes the end-to-end flow validation required by the constitution.
findings.evidence: The plan substitutes prompt tracing for live fixture trials, and T016 records only that trace. Constitution Development Workflow requires flow changes to be validated end to end under DESIGN.md's Validation plan before reliance; prompt inspection cannot demonstrate routing, handoff or resume behavior. ENG-31 requires verified delivery.
findings.fix: Perform and record the applicable end-to-end validation, including a UI-design run and interrupted/resumed implementation, or obtain a documented constitutional exception before relying on the change.
